name: Thoracic Extension & Foam Roller Opener
instructions: Place the foam roller perpendicular to your spine across your mid-back / shoulder blade area.
Support your head with your hands, keeping your elbows wide.
Inhale and gently extend backward over the roller, then exhale and return to neutral without arching lower back.
Move up and down 1-2 inches along the thoracic spine.
posture_benefit: Counters forward head posture and rounded shoulders from desk work.

name: Wall Angels with Scapular Retraction
instructions: Stand with back flat against a wall, heels 3-4 inches away.
Press lower back, upper back, and head gently into the wall.
Bring elbows and backs of wrists to touch the wall in a 'W' or 'goalpost' shape.
Slowly slide arms upward overhead maintaining wall contact as much as comfortable, then return.
posture_benefit: Activates mid-back postural stabilizers and opens anterior shoulder capsule.

name: Bird-Dog Core & Posterior Chain Integration
target_muscle: Transverse Abdominis, Gluteus Maximus, Erector Spinae
instructions: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees directly under hips.
Engage your deep core and brace as if about to be poked in the ribs.
Simultaneously reach your right arm forward and left leg backward until parallel to the floor.
Hold for 2 seconds at the top without rotating hips or arching lumbar spine, then switch sides.
posture_benefit: Reinforces neutral pelvic alignment and anti-rotational spinal endurance.

name: Glute Bridge with Isometric Hold
instructions: Lie on back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor hip-width apart.
Press through heels and squeeze glutes to elevate hips until hips, knees and shoulders form a straight line.
Hold the contraction at the peak for 3 seconds without over-extending lumbar spine.
Lower under control and repeat.
posture_benefit: Counters anterior pelvic tilt caused by prolonged sedentary sitting.

name: Dead Bug Anti-Extension Core Control
instructions: Lie on back with arms reaching toward ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Flatten lower back firmly into the floor so there is zero gap.
Slowly extend right arm overhead and left leg outward just above the floor.
Return to starting point and repeat with opposite limbs while maintaining flat spine.
posture_benefit: Teaches pelvic stabilization and deep anterior abdominal brace.

name: Bodyweight Tempo Squats
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly outward.
Descend over 3 seconds by hinging at hips and bending knees, keeping chest lifted.
Descend until thighs are parallel to ground, pause for 1 second, then drive up powerfully.
Keep knees tracking in line with second toes throughout.
posture_benefit: Builds fundamental lower-body metabolic strength and hip mobility.

name: Elevated Push-Ups / Standard Push-Ups
instructions: Set hands slightly wider than shoulder-width on floor (or bench for elevation).
Form a rigid plank line from crown of head to heels, glutes squeezed.
Lower chest towards ground by breaking at elbows at a 45-degree angle.
Press through full palms back to locked plank position.
posture_benefit: Develops horizontal pressing power and total body bracing stamina.
